notes.title: Blon will be released on the 07th of September 2021 on PC and Mobile!
notes.content:
We are proud to announce today the release date of Blon, which will be on September 07, 2021!

Blon will be available on Steam, but also on the Apple Store for iPhone and iPad and on the Google Play Store for Android. 

Don't forget to add the game to your Steam wishlist to make sure you don't miss the launch:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1582990/Blon/



- Lazy Kiwi

notes.title: Join the Blob adventure!
notes.content:
Welcome to Blon! Blon is a cute 2D platformer in which you have to save your family and defeat your mad brother by defeating dozens of enemies and bosses.

Blon is participating in the Steam Next Fest which runs from June 16th to 22nd. Don't hesitate to playtest the demo of the game which is available during this period on Steam.

You can already add the game to your wishlist by clicking right here:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1582990/Blon/


- Lazy Kiwi
